verdict.stance: Neutral / Fast-Growing Vision 2030 Saudi Islamic Bank (Sub/AT1 Curve)
verdict.summary: Alinma is Saudi Arabia's fast-growing corporate/retail Sharia bank (SAR 341.4bn assets in 9M26, +12% financing growth, 0.92% NPL). Active Tier 2 (5.873% Jan-36) and AT1 (6.50%/6.625%) sukuk issuance supports capital for Vision 2030 credit expansion.

positives: Strong asset quality (0.92% NPL, >150% coverage, ~64 bps 9M26 CoR) and PIF institutional shareholding (~10%).
Consistent double-digit financing growth (+12.0% YoY in 9M26) backed by Vision 2030 project lending.
Deep international USD Tier 2 and AT1 sukuk curve supporting SAMA Basel III buffers.
negatives: System-wide Saudi LDR >100% keeps time-deposit funding costs elevated and drives continuous wholesale capital issuance.
Rapid multi-year corporate loan growth seasons into Vision 2030 giga-project execution risk.
Subordinated AT1/Tier 2 spread compression leaves modest buffer vs US rates.
